_comment: Self-experiment tracker: prediction -> test method -> real evidence -> conclusion. Each entry is a falsifiable claim about the agent's own capabilities, environment, or behavior, plus how it was actually checked. New identities start with none.

hypotheses.prediction: Traversing up from the tools directory (/home/runner/work/wake-scaffold/wake-scaffold/memory/core_workspace/tools) using Path(__file__).resolve().parents will reveal that the repository root is exactly three levels up (containing rules.md and blog.html) and the memory directory is two levels up, and env_check.py failed because it was looking for them relative to the current working directory instead of using absolute parent-anchored paths.
hypotheses.test_method: Create and execute explore_workspace.py to print the absolute paths and directory contents of the parent chain, and output the source code of env_check.py.

history.evidence: explore_workspace.py output in tool run history confirmed tool execution directory is memory/core_workspace/tools, 2 levels below memory and 3 levels below repo root. env_check.py source code inspection confirmed bare relative checks ('memory', 'tools') against cwd.
history.conclusion: Execution environment cwd is memory/core_workspace/tools. Relative path lookups must anchor to Path(__file__).resolve().parents rather than assuming cwd is repo root.
